class.name: StudioApiClient
class.brief_description: Non-blocking HTTP client for the Studio Server REST API.
class.description: [StudioApiClient] queries the Studio Server ([code]/v1/me/projects[/code], [code]/v1/users/{id}/projects[/code], [code]/v1/me/workspaces[/code], [code]/v1/users/{id}/workspaces[/code], [code]/v1/configs/{tool}[/code], and [code]/v1/projects/{projectRef}/configs/{tool}[/code]) using the active [Authentik] bearer token or a [code]STUDIO_KEY[/code] service key.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Cancels any in-flight HTTP request to the Studio Server.

method.name: fetch_my_projects
method.description: Fetches Studio projects accessible to the authenticated user via [code]GET /v1/me/projects[/code] and emits [signal projects_loaded].

method.name: fetch_my_workspaces
method.description: Fetches VCS workspaces, tasks, and pipeline artifacts for the authenticated user via [code]GET /v1/me/workspaces[/code] and emits [signal workspaces_loaded].

method.name: fetch_project_config
method.description: Fetches a project-scoped tool configuration manifest (in [code]json[/code] or [code]yaml[/code] format) for [param project_ref] (project UUID or slug) via [code]GET /v1/projects/{project_ref}/configs/{tool}[/code] and emits [signal config_loaded].

method.name: fetch_studio_config
method.description: Fetches a generalist studio-wide tool configuration manifest (in [code]json[/code] or [code]yaml[/code] format) via [code]GET /v1/configs/{tool}[/code] and emits [signal config_loaded].

method.name: fetch_user_projects
method.description: Fetches Studio projects accessible to [param identifier] (UUID, username, email, or Wiki ID) via [code]GET /v1/users/{id}/projects[/code] and emits [signal projects_loaded].

method.name: fetch_user_workspaces
method.description: Fetches VCS workspaces (for example Lore repositories) for [param identifier] via [code]GET /v1/users/{id}/workspaces[/code] and emits [signal workspaces_loaded].

method.name: get_bearer_token
method.description: Returns the explicit bearer token override set via [method set_bearer_token], or an empty string when delegating to [Authentik].

method.name: get_last_config
method.description: Returns the most recently loaded JSON configuration manifest [Dictionary] (empty when the last configuration was fetched as [code]yaml[/code]).

method.name: get_last_config_raw
method.description: Returns the raw UTF-8 payload (JSON or YAML) from the most recent [method fetch_studio_config] or [method fetch_project_config] request.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the human-readable error message from the last failed request.

method.name: get_last_http_code
method.description: Returns the HTTP status code from the most recent completed request, or [code]0[/code] for local/network errors.

method.name: get_last_projects
method.description: Returns the most recently loaded [Array] of project dictionaries.

method.name: get_last_user
method.description: Returns the subject identity [Dictionary] returned alongside the last successful query.

method.name: get_last_workspaces
method.description: Returns the most recently loaded [Array] of workspace dictionaries.

method.name: get_service_key
method.description: Returns the explicit [code]X-Studio-Key[/code] service key override set via [method set_service_key].

method.name: has_credentials
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if an Authentik bearer token or [code]STUDIO_KEY[/code] service key is available.

method.name: is_busy
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while an HTTP request is in flight.

method.name: is_configured
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a valid Studio Server URL is configured.

method.name: poll
method.description: Advances any pending HTTP request. Called automatically each frame when a [SceneTree] is active; call manually in headless scripts without frame ticks.

method.name: set_bearer_token
method.description: Sets an explicit OAuth 2.0 / OIDC bearer token, overriding the global [Authentik] session token when non-empty.

method.name: set_service_key
method.description: Sets an explicit [code]X-Studio-Key[/code] ([code]stk_...[/code]) service key for automated or headless Studio API calls.

members.member: Base URL of the Studio Server (defaults to [method Authentik.get_studio_api_url] when unset).
If [code]true[/code], verifies TLS server certificates on HTTPS connections.

signal.name: config_loaded
signal.description: Emitted when [method fetch_studio_config] or [method fetch_project_config] succeeds.

signal.name: projects_loaded
signal.description: Emitted when [method fetch_my_projects] or [method fetch_user_projects] succeeds.

signal.name: request_failed
signal.description: Emitted when a Studio Server request fails.

signal.name: workspaces_loaded
signal.description: Emitted when [method fetch_my_workspaces] or [method fetch_user_workspaces] succeeds.
